items.q: How does an engagement with Techno Horizon typically begin?
items.a: Engagements typically begin with an initial scoping consultation or RFP review. Following requirements discovery, our team submits a formal proposal or technical schedule outlining deliverables, milestones, governance structure, and commercial terms aligned with institutional procurement standards.

items.q: Can Techno Horizon participate in government and PSU tenders?
items.a: Yes. Techno Horizon participates in public tenders, RFPs, and institutional bids across custom software development, systems integration, process consulting (BPR/DPR), and manpower solutions. Tenders can be coordinated via contact@technohorizon.co.in.

items.q: Is Techno Horizon a SaaS product company with subscription pricing?
items.a: No. Techno Horizon is an enterprise technology, institutional advisory, and workforce solutions partner. We deliver tailored software engineering, custom consulting, and dedicated staffing under agreed scopes of work, rather than off-the-shelf software subscriptions or self-service packages.

items.q: What technology stacks do you specialize in?
items.a: Our engineering teams build with modern, resilient architectures including React, Node.js, Python, Java enterprise stacks, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and secure cloud/on-premise Linux environments, with a strong emphasis on REST/SOAP API integration and role-based security.

items.q: Do you offer post-implementation software support and maintenance?
items.a: Yes. We provide comprehensive application maintenance, vulnerability remediation, feature enhancements, and database optimization under defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

items.q: What is included in a Detailed Project Report (DPR)?
items.a: A typical Techno Horizon DPR includes comprehensive requirement scoping, baseline gap assessments, technological and operational feasibility studies, financial expenditure projections, implementation roadmaps, risk registers, and procurement schedules.

items.q: How does BPR integrate with your software development capabilities?
items.a: Our business analysts diagnose and streamline administrative workflows first, creating future-state process maps that directly inform the system architecture, database schema, and UI flows of the resulting software solution.

items.q: How are manpower candidates vetted for institutional deployments?
items.a: Candidates undergo multi-stage technical assessments, identity and credential verification, previous employer reference checks, and background screening prior to institutional onboarding.

items.q: Can training sessions be customized for specific departmental software?
items.a: Yes. Our instructional team conducts a thorough Training Needs Analysis (TNA) and authors custom bilingual curricula, interactive simulation labs, and facilitator guides reflecting your specific software and operational rules.
